operations.title: Limpeza Rápida Completa
operations.command: Remove-Item "$env:TEMP\*" -Recurse -Force -EA 0; Remove-Item "C:\Windows\Temp\*" -Recurse -Force -EA 0; Clear-RecycleBin -Force -EA 0; Write-Host "✅ Limpeza concluída!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Limpar TEMP Usuário
operations.command: Remove-Item -Path "$env:TEMP\*" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

operations.title: Limpar TEMP do Windows
operations.command: Remove-Item -Path "C:\Windows\Temp\*" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

operations.title: Esvaziar Lixeira
operations.command: Clear-RecycleBin -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host "✅ Lixeira esvaziada!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Limpar Cache do Windows Update
operations.command: Stop-Service wuauserv -Force; Remove-Item "C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution\Download\*" -Recurse -Force -EA 0; Start-Service wuauserv; Write-Host "✅ Cache WU limpo!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Limpar Prefetch
operations.command: Remove-Item "C:\Windows\Prefetch\*" -Force -EA 0; Write-Host "✅ Prefetch limpo!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Limpar Minidump (crash logs)
operations.command: Remove-Item "C:\Windows\Minidump\*" -Force -EA 0; Remove-Item "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\CrashDumps\*" -Recurse -Force -EA 0; Write-Host "✅ Dumps limpos!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Limpar Cache DNS
operations.command: ipconfig /flushdns; Write-Host "✅ Cache DNS limpo!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Limpeza Profunda (tudo)
operations.command: Remove-Item "$env:TEMP\*" -Recurse -Force -EA 0; Remove-Item "C:\Windows\Temp\*" -Recurse -Force -EA 0; Remove-Item "C:\Windows\Prefetch\*" -Force -EA 0; Clear-RecycleBin -Force -EA 0; ipconfig /flushdns; Write-Host "✅ Limpeza profunda concluída!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Limpar Cache do Chrome
operations.command: Remove-Item "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\Cache\*" -Recurse -Force -EA 0; Remove-Item "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\Code Cache\*" -Recurse -Force -EA 0; Write-Host "✅ Cache Chrome limpo!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Limpar Cache do Teams
operations.command: Remove-Item "$env:APPDATA\Microsoft\Teams\Cache\*" -Recurse -Force -EA 0; Remove-Item "$env:APPDATA\Microsoft\Teams\blob_storage\*" -Recurse -Force -EA 0; Remove-Item "$env:APPDATA\Microsoft\Teams\databases\*" -Recurse -Force -EA 0; Write-Host "✅ Cache Teams limpo!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Limpar Arquivos Antigos do Downloads (>30 dias)
operations.command: Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads" -File | Where-Object { $_.LastWriteTime -lt (Get-Date).AddDays(-30) } | Remove-Item -Force -EA 0; Write-Host "✅ Downloads antigos removidos!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Limpar Cache de Fontes
operations.command: Stop-Service FontCache -Force -EA 0; Remove-Item "$env:WINDIR\ServiceProfiles\LocalService\AppData\Local\FontCache\*" -Recurse -Force -EA 0; Start-Service FontCache; Write-Host "✅ Cache de fontes limpo!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Cleanmgr Modo Silencioso
operations.command: cleanmgr /sagerun:1; Write-Host "✅ Limpeza de disco iniciada!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Configurar Cleanmgr Automático
operations.command: cleanmgr /sageset:1

operations.title: Limpar Arquivos de Log do Windows
operations.command: Remove-Item "C:\Windows\Logs\*" -Recurse -Force -EA 0; Write-Host "✅ Logs limpos!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Limpar EventViewer Logs
operations.command: Get-EventLog -List | ForEach-Object { Clear-EventLog -LogName $_.Log -EA 0 }; Write-Host "✅ Logs de eventos limpos!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Limpar Cache do Microsoft Store
operations.command: wsreset.exe; Write-Host "✅ Cache do Store limpo!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Limpar Cache do Navegador Edge
operations.command: Remove-Item "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\Default\Cache\*" -Recurse -Force -EA 0; Write-Host "✅ Cache Edge limpo!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Limpar Thumbnail Cache
operations.command: ie4uinit.exe -show; Remove-Item "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer\thumbcache_*" -Force -EA 0; Write-Host "✅ Thumbnail cache limpo!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Compactar WinSxS (DISM)
operations.command: DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /StartComponentCleanup /ResetBase

operations.title: Limpar Arquivos Desnecessários do Sistema
operations.command: DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /StartComponentCleanup

operations.title: Limpar Cache do Spotify
operations.command: Remove-Item "$env:APPDATA\Spotify\Storage\*" -Recurse -Force -EA 0; Write-Host "✅ Cache Spotify limpo!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Limpar Cache do Discord
operations.command: Remove-Item "$env:APPDATA\discord\Cache\*" -Recurse -Force -EA 0; Remove-Item "$env:APPDATA\discord\Code Cache\*" -Recurse -Force -EA 0; Write-Host "✅ Cache Discord limpo!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Remover Arquivos .tmp do Sistema
operations.command: Get-ChildItem C:\ -Recurse -Filter *.tmp -EA 0 | Where-Object { !$_.PSIsContainer } | Remove-Item -Force -EA 0; Write-Host "✅ Arquivos .tmp removidos!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Liberar Memória RAM Imediatamente
operations.command: [System.GC]::Collect(); [System.GC]::WaitForPendingFinalizers(); Write-Host "✅ RAM liberada!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Ver Uso Atual de RAM
operations.command: $ram = Get-WmiObject Win32_OperatingSystem; $livre = [math]::Round($ram.FreePhysicalMemory/1MB,2); $total = [math]::Round($ram.TotalVisibleMemorySize/1MB,2); Write-Host "RAM Livre: $livre GB de $total GB" -ForegroundColor Cyan

operations.title: Listar Processos por Uso de RAM
operations.command: Get-Process | Sort-Object WorkingSet64 -Descending | Select-Object -First 15 Name,@{N="RAM(MB)";E={[math]::Round($_.WorkingSet64/1MB,2)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize

operations.title: Desativar SuperFetch (SysMain)
operations.command: Set-Service -Name "SysMain" -StartupType Disabled; Stop-Service -Name "SysMain" -Force; Write-Host "✅ SysMain desativado!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Reativar SuperFetch (SysMain)
operations.command: Set-Service -Name "SysMain" -StartupType Automatic; Start-Service -Name "SysMain"; Write-Host "✅ SysMain reativado!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Verificar Modo de Memória Virtual
operations.command: $cs = Get-ComputerInfo; Write-Host "Paginação: $($cs.OsMaxProcessMemorySize) KB" -ForegroundColor Cyan

operations.title: Limpar Standby Memory (RAMMap)
operations.command: Write-Host "Baixe RAMMap da Sysinternals para limpar Standby Memory manualmente." -ForegroundColor Yellow

operations.title: Listar Processos Ativos
operations.command: Get-Process | Sort-Object CPU -Descending | Select-Object -First 20 Name,Id,CPU,@{N="RAM(MB)";E={[math]::Round($_.WorkingSet64/1MB,1)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize

operations.title: Encerrar Processo por Nome
operations.command: Stop-Process -Name "NOME_DO_PROCESSO" -Force -EA 0; Write-Host "✅ Processo encerrado!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Encerrar Todos Chrome
operations.command: Stop-Process -Name "chrome" -Force -EA 0; Write-Host "✅ Chrome encerrado!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Encerrar Todos Edge
operations.command: Stop-Process -Name "msedge" -Force -EA 0; Write-Host "✅ Edge encerrado!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Listar Serviços em Execução
operations.command: Get-Service | Where-Object Status -eq "Running" | Sort-Object DisplayName | Format-Table -AutoSize

operations.title: Listar Startups do Sistema
operations.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_StartupCommand | Select-Object Name,Command,User | Format-Table -AutoSize

operations.title: Desativar Serviço por Nome
operations.command: Set-Service -Name "NOME_SERVICO" -StartupType Disabled; Stop-Service "NOME_SERVICO" -Force

operations.title: Reiniciar Explorer
operations.command: Stop-Process -Name explorer -Force; Start-Process explorer; Write-Host "✅ Explorer reiniciado!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Ver tarefas agendadas
operations.command: Get-ScheduledTask | Where-Object State -eq "Ready" | Select-Object TaskName,TaskPath | Format-Table -AutoSize

operations.title: Verificar Espaço em Disco
operations.command: Get-PSDrive -PSProvider FileSystem | Select-Object Name,@{N="Usado(GB)";E={[math]::Round(($_.Used/1GB),2)}},@{N="Livre(GB)";E={[math]::Round(($_.Free/1GB),2)}},@{N="Total(GB)";E={[math]::Round((($_.Used+$_.Free)/1GB),2)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize

operations.title: CHKDSK Verificação Rápida
operations.command: chkdsk C: /f /r; Write-Host "✅ CHKDSK agendado para o próximo boot!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Otimizar / Desfragmentar Disco
operations.command: Optimize-Volume -DriveLetter C -Defrag -Verbose

operations.title: Trim SSD
operations.command: Optimize-Volume -DriveLetter C -ReTrim -Verbose; Write-Host "✅ TRIM executado!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Verificar Saúde do Disco (SMART)
operations.command: Get-WmiObject -Namespace root/wmi -Class MSStorageDriver_FailurePredictStatus | Select-Object PredictFailure,Reason | Format-Table -AutoSize

operations.title: Encontrar Pastas Gigantes (C:)
operations.command: Get-ChildItem C: -Directory | ForEach-Object { $s=(Get-ChildItem $_.FullName -Recurse -EA 0 | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum; [PSCustomObject]@{Pasta=$_.Name;GB=[math]::Round($s/1GB,2)} } | Sort-Object GB -Desc | Select-Object -First 15 | Format-Table

operations.title: Desativar Hibernação (libera espaço)
operations.command: powercfg -h off; Write-Host "✅ Hibernação desativada, hiberfil.sys removido!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Ativar Hibernação
operations.command: powercfg -h on; Write-Host "✅ Hibernação ativada!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Diagnóstico de Rede Completo
operations.command: ipconfig /all

operations.title: Testar Conectividade com a Internet
operations.command: Test-Connection -ComputerName 8.8.8.8 -Count 4 | Format-Table -AutoSize

operations.title: Velocidade de Download (Teste rápido)
operations.command: Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://speedtest.tele2.net/1MB.zip" -OutFile "$env:TEMP\test.zip" -UseBasicParsing; Write-Host "✅ Download concluído!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Flush e Renovar IP
operations.command: ipconfig /flushdns; ipconfig /release; ipconfig /renew; Write-Host "✅ IP renovado!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Resetar Pilha TCP/IP
operations.command: netsh int ip reset; netsh winsock reset; Write-Host "✅ TCP/IP resetado! Reinicie o PC." -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Ver Adaptadores de Rede
operations.command: Get-NetAdapter | Select-Object Name,Status,LinkSpeed,MacAddress | Format-Table -AutoSize

operations.title: Testar DNS
operations.command: Resolve-DnsName google.com; Resolve-DnsName cloudflare.com

operations.title: Ping para múltiplos servidores
operations.command: "8.8.8.8","1.1.1.1","208.67.222.222" | ForEach-Object { $r=Test-Connection $_ -Count 1 -EA 0; Write-Host "$_ -> $($r.ResponseTime)ms" }

operations.title: SFC Scan (Reparo de Arquivos)
operations.command: sfc /scannow

operations.title: DISM Restaurar Saúde
operations.command: DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth

operations.title: DISM Verificar Saúde
operations.command: DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /CheckHealth

operations.title: DISM Scan Saúde
operations.command: DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /ScanHealth

operations.title: Reparar Windows Update
operations.command: net stop wuauserv; net stop cryptSvc; net stop bits; net stop msiserver; Remove-Item "C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution" -Recurse -Force -EA 0; net start wuauserv; net start cryptSvc; net start bits; net start msiserver; Write-Host "✅ WU reparado!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Reparar .NET Framework
operations.command: DISM /Online /Enable-Feature /FeatureName:NetFx3 /All

operations.title: Verificar Erros de Boot
operations.command: bootrec /scanos; bootrec /fixmbr; bootrec /fixboot; bootrec /rebuildbcd

operations.title: Reparar Registro do Windows
operations.command: $ErrorActionPreference="SilentlyContinue"; $reg="HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion"; Write-Host "Versão: $((Get-ItemProperty $reg).ProductName)" -ForegroundColor Cyan

operations.title: Atualizar PowerShell para 7+
operations.command: winget install Microsoft.PowerShell --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements; Write-Host "✅ Atualização do PowerShell iniciada!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Atualizar Terminais (CMD, PowerShell, Windows Terminal)
operations.command: winget upgrade Microsoft.WindowsTerminal --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements; winget upgrade Microsoft.PowerShell --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements; Write-Host "✅ Atualização concluída." -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Relatório rápido do PC
operations.command: $os=Get-WmiObject Win32_OperatingSystem; $cpu=Get-WmiObject Win32_Processor | Select-Object -First 1; $disk=Get-PSDrive C; $ramLivre=[math]::Round($os.FreePhysicalMemory/1MB,2); $ramTotal=[math]::Round($os.TotalVisibleMemorySize/1MB,2); $diskLivre=[math]::Round($disk.Free/1GB,2); $diskTotal=[math]::Round(($disk.Used+$disk.Free)/1GB,2); $boot=[Management.ManagementDateTimeConverter]::ToDateTime($os.LastBootUpTime); $uptime=New-TimeSpan -Start $boot -End (Get-Date); Write-Host "===== RELATORIO RAPIDO DO PC =====" -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host "Computador: $env:COMPUTERNAME"; Write-Host "Windows: $($os.Caption) Build $($os.BuildNumber)"; Write-Host "CPU: $($cpu.Name)"; Write-Host "RAM: $ramLivre GB livre de $ramTotal GB"; Write-Host "Disco C: $diskLivre GB livre de $diskTotal GB"; Write-Host "Uptime: $($uptime.Days)d $($uptime.Hours)h"; Write-Host ""; Write-Host "Top 10 processos por RAM:" -ForegroundColor Yellow; Get-Process | Sort-Object WorkingSet64 -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 Name,@{N="RAM(MB)";E={[math]::Round($_.WorkingSet64/1MB,2)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Host ""; if(Test-Connection 8.8.8.8 -Count 1 -Quiet){Write-Host "Internet: OK" -ForegroundColor Green}else{Write-Host "Internet: SEM CONEXAO" -ForegroundColor Red}

operations.title: Exportar diagnóstico para logs
operations.command: $project=$env:MESTRE_PROJETO_PATH; if(-not $project){ throw "MESTRE_PROJETO_PATH não definido." }; $logDir=Join-Path $project "logs"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $logDir | Out-Null; $file=Join-Path $logDir ("diagnostico-"+(Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss")+".txt"); $os=Get-WmiObject Win32_OperatingSystem; $disk=Get-PSDrive C; $top=Get-Process | Sort-Object WorkingSet64 -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 Name,@{N="RAM(MB)";E={[math]::Round($_.WorkingSet64/1MB,2)}} | Out-String; @("===== DIAGNOSTICO MESTRE DO PC =====","Data: $(Get-Date)","Computador: $env:COMPUTERNAME","Windows: $($os.Caption) Build $($os.BuildNumber)","RAM livre GB: $([math]::Round($os.FreePhysicalMemory/1MB,2))","Disco C livre GB: $([math]::Round($disk.Free/1GB,2))","",$top) | Set-Content -Path $file -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host "Diagnostico salvo em: $file" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Listar modelos Ollama
operations.command: try { $data=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:11434/api/tags" -TimeoutSec 5); Write-Host "Modelos Ollama instalados:" -ForegroundColor Cyan; if(-not $data.models){ Write-Host "Nenhum modelo retornado pelo Ollama." -ForegroundColor Yellow } else { $data.models | ForEach-Object { $cloud=if($_.name -match "cloud"){ " [cloud]" } else { "" }; Write-Host ("- " + $_.name + $cloud) } } } catch { Write-Host "Ollama offline ou inacessivel em localhost:11434" -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host $_.Exception.Message }

operations.title: Testar Ollama (qwen3-coder-next:cloud)
operations.command: $model="qwen3-coder-next:cloud"; try { $body=@{model=$model;messages=@(@{role="user";content="Responda somente OK"});stream=$false} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6; $res=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:11434/api/chat" -Method POST -ContentType "application/json" -Body $body -TimeoutSec 30; Write-Host "Modelo testado: $model" -ForegroundColor Cyan; if($res.message.content){ Write-Host $res.message.content -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host "Ollama respondeu, mas sem conteudo de chat." -ForegroundColor Yellow } } catch { Write-Host "Falha no teste do Ollama/modelo. Talvez o modelo nao suporte chat ou esteja offline." -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host $_.Exception.Message }

operations.title: Abrir pasta do projeto
operations.command: $project=$env:MESTRE_PROJETO_PATH; if(-not $project){ throw "MESTRE_PROJETO_PATH não definido." }; Start-Process $project; Write-Host "Pasta do projeto aberta: $project" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Abrir pasta de logs
operations.command: $project=$env:MESTRE_PROJETO_PATH; if(-not $project){ throw "MESTRE_PROJETO_PATH não definido." }; $logDir=Join-Path $project "logs"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $logDir | Out-Null; Start-Process $logDir; Write-Host "Pasta de logs aberta: $logDir" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Abrir TEMP do usuário
operations.command: Start-Process $env:TEMP; Write-Host "TEMP aberto: $env:TEMP" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Abrir Startup do usuário
operations.command: $startup=[Environment]::GetFolderPath("Startup"); Start-Process $startup; Write-Host "Startup aberto: $startup" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Ver tarefas MestreDoPC
operations.command: $names=@("MestreDoPC_Admin_Launcher","MestreDoPC_Startup"); $rows=foreach($name in $names){ $task=Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($task){ $info=Get-ScheduledTaskInfo -TaskName $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; [pscustomobject]@{Task=$name;State=$task.State;LastRun=$info.LastRunTime;LastResult=$info.LastTaskResult;NextRun=$info.NextRunTime} } else { [pscustomobject]@{Task=$name;State="Nao encontrada";LastRun="";LastResult="";NextRun=""} } }; $rows | Format-Table -AutoSize

operations.title: Checkup Geral (Resumo Completo)
operations.command: $os=Get-WmiObject Win32_OperatingSystem; $cpu=Get-WmiObject Win32_Processor; $disk=Get-PSDrive C; $ram=[math]::Round($os.FreePhysicalMemory/1MB,1); $totalRam=[math]::Round($os.TotalVisibleMemorySize/1MB,1); $diskFree=[math]::Round($disk.Free/1GB,1); $diskTotal=[math]::Round(($disk.Used+$disk.Free)/1GB,1); $up=[Management.ManagementDateTimeConverter]::ToDateTime($os.LastBootUpTime); $days=([datetime]::Now-$up).Days; Write-Host "=== CHECKUP DO PC ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host "CPU: $($cpu.Name)" -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host "RAM: $ram GB livre de $totalRam GB" -ForegroundColor $(if($ram -lt 2){"Red"}else{"Green"}); Write-Host "Disco C: $diskFree GB livre de $diskTotal GB" -ForegroundColor $(if($diskFree -lt 20){"Red"}else{"Green"}); Write-Host "Uptime: $days dias" -ForegroundColor $(if($days -gt 7){"Yellow"}else{"Green"}); Write-Host "Windows: $($os.Caption) Build $($os.BuildNumber)" -ForegroundColor White

operations.title: Verificar Integridade do Sistema (SFC + DISM)
operations.command: Write-Host "Etapa 1/2: DISM..." -ForegroundColor Yellow; DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /ScanHealth; Write-Host "Etapa 2/2: SFC..." -ForegroundColor Yellow; sfc /scannow; Write-Host "✅ Verificação completa!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Verificar Atualizações Pendentes
operations.command: $updates = (New-Object -ComObject Microsoft.Update.Session).CreateUpdateSearcher().Search("IsInstalled=0"); if($updates.Updates.Count -gt 0) { Write-Host "$($updates.Updates.Count) atualizações pendentes:" -ForegroundColor Yellow; $updates.Updates | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  - $($_.Title)" } } else { Write-Host "✅ Sistema atualizado!" -ForegroundColor Green }

operations.title: Verificar Versão da BIOS/UEFI
operations.command: Get-WmiObject Win32_BIOS | Select-Object Manufacturer,Name,SMBIOSBIOSVersion,ReleaseDate | Format-List

operations.title: Verificar Saúde do Disco (SMART)
operations.command: Get-PhysicalDisk | Select-Object FriendlyName,MediaType,HealthStatus,OperationalStatus,@{N="Tamanho(GB)";E={[math]::Round($_.Size/1GB,1)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize

operations.title: Listar Drivers Desatualizados
operations.command: Get-WmiObject Win32_PnPSignedDriver | Where-Object {$_.DriverDate} | Select-Object DeviceName,DriverVersion,@{N="Data";E={[Management.ManagementDateTimeConverter]::ToDateTime($_.DriverDate).ToString("dd/MM/yyyy")}} | Sort-Object Data | Select-Object -First 15 | Format-Table -AutoSize

operations.title: Verificar Erros Recentes do Sistema
operations.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName="System";Level=2;StartTime=(Get-Date).AddDays(-7)} -MaxEvents 15 -EA 0 | Select-Object TimeCreated,Id,Message | Format-Table -Wrap -AutoSize

operations.title: Tempo de Boot do Windows
operations.command: $boot = (Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName="System";Id=6005} -MaxEvents 1).TimeCreated; $ready = (Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName="System";Id=6013} -MaxEvents 1 -EA 0); Write-Host "Último boot: $boot" -ForegroundColor Cyan

operations.title: Informações do Sistema
operations.command: Get-ComputerInfo | Select-Object WindowsProductName,WindowsVersion,OsArchitecture,CsName,CsProcessors,CsTotalPhysicalMemory | Format-List

operations.title: Temperatura do CPU (WMI)
operations.command: Get-WmiObject MSAcpi_ThermalZoneTemperature -Namespace "root/wmi" | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "Zona: $($_.InstanceName) -> $(($_.CurrentTemperature - 2732)/10)°C" }

operations.title: Histórico de Erros do Sistema
operations.command: Get-EventLog -LogName System -EntryType Error -Newest 20 | Select-Object TimeGenerated,Source,Message | Format-Table -AutoSize

operations.title: Uptime do Sistema
operations.command: $boot=(Get-WmiObject Win32_OperatingSystem).LastBootUpTime; $up=[Management.ManagementDateTimeConverter]::ToDateTime($boot); Write-Host "Ligado desde: $up ($(([datetime]::Now - $up).Days)d $(([datetime]::Now - $up).Hours)h)" -ForegroundColor Cyan

operations.title: Placa de Vídeo (GPU)
operations.command: Get-WmiObject Win32_VideoController | Select-Object Name,DriverVersion,@{N="VRAM(GB)";E={[math]::Round($_.AdapterRAM/1GB,2)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize

operations.title: Inventário de Software Instalado
operations.command: Get-WmiObject Win32_Product | Select-Object Name,Version | Sort-Object Name | Format-Table -AutoSize

operations.title: Verificar Drivers Problemáticos
operations.command: Get-WmiObject Win32_PnPEntity | Where-Object ConfigManagerErrorCode -ne 0 | Select-Object Name,ConfigManagerErrorCode | Format-Table -AutoSize

operations.title: Desligar Agora
operations.command: Stop-Computer -Force

operations.title: Reiniciar Agora
operations.command: Restart-Computer -Force

operations.title: Desligar em 60 segundos
operations.command: shutdown /s /t 60; Write-Host "⏱️ PC desligará em 60s. Use shutdown /a para cancelar." -ForegroundColor Yellow

operations.title: Cancelar Desligamento Agendado
operations.command: shutdown /a; Write-Host "✅ Desligamento cancelado!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Suspender o PC
operations.command: Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms; [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::SetSuspendState("Suspend",$false,$false)

operations.title: Hibernar o PC
operations.command: shutdown /h

operations.title: Desligar em 30 minutos
operations.command: shutdown /s /t 1800; Write-Host "⏱️ PC desligará em 30 minutos." -ForegroundColor Yellow

operations.title: Reiniciar para BIOS/UEFI
operations.command: shutdown /r /fw /t 5; Write-Host "🔄 Reiniciando para UEFI em 5s..." -ForegroundColor Cyan

operations.title: Git Status do Projeto
operations.command: Set-Location -LiteralPath $env:MESTRE_PROJETO_PATH; git status

operations.title: Git Add + Commit + Push
operations.command: Set-Location -LiteralPath $env:MESTRE_PROJETO_PATH; git add -A; git commit -m "feat: atualização automática $(Get-Date -Format dd/MM/yyyy)"; git push; Write-Host "✅ Push realizado!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Git Pull (Atualizar Local)
operations.command: Set-Location -LiteralPath $env:MESTRE_PROJETO_PATH; git pull; Write-Host "✅ Repositório atualizado!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Git Log (Últimos 10)
operations.command: Set-Location -LiteralPath $env:MESTRE_PROJETO_PATH; git log --oneline -10

operations.title: Ver Branch Atual
operations.command: Set-Location -LiteralPath $env:MESTRE_PROJETO_PATH; git branch -v

operations.title: Configurar Git (nome/email)
operations.command: git config --global user.name "Jeanc"; git config --global user.email "seu@email.com"; Write-Host "✅ Git configurado!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Ver Configuração do Git
operations.command: git config --list --global

operations.title: Clonar Repositório
operations.command: git clone https://github.com/USUARIO/REPO.git "C:\Projetos\REPO"; Write-Host "✅ Clonado!" -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Git Stash (Salvar mudanças temporariamente)

operations.title: Scan Rápido com Defender

operations.title: Scan Completo com Defender

operations.title: Verificar Firewall do Windows

operations.title: Ativar Firewall em todos os perfis

operations.title: Ver Regras de Firewall Ativas

operations.title: Listar Processos Suspeitos (sem assinatura)

operations.title: DNS Cloudflare Seguro (1.1.1.1)

operations.title: DNS Google (8.8.8.8)

operations.title: DNS OpenDNS (Família)

operations.title: Ver DNS Atual

operations.title: Desativar IPv6

operations.title: Verificar VPN/Proxy ativo
operations.command: netsh winhttp show proxy; Get-ItemProperty "HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Internet Settings" | Select-Object ProxyEnable,ProxyServer

operations.title: Ativar Modo Jogo (Game Mode)

operations.title: Desativar Modo Jogo
operations.command: Set-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\GameBar' -Name 'AutoGameModeEnabled' -Value 0; Write-Host '✅ Modo Jogo desativado!' -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Plano de Energia Alto Desempenho

operations.title: Plano de Energia Equilibrado
operations.command: powercfg /setactive 381b4222-f694-41f0-9685-ff5bb260df2e; Write-Host '✅ Plano equilibrado ativado!' -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Plano de Energia Economia
operations.command: powercfg /setactive a1841308-3541-4fab-bc81-f71556f20b4a; Write-Host '✅ Economia de energia ativada!' -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Desativar Efeitos Visuais (Performance)
operations.command: Set-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\VisualEffects' -Name 'VisualFXSetting' -Value 2; Write-Host '✅ Efeitos visuais otimizados para performance!' -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Restaurar Efeitos Visuais (Padrão)
operations.command: Set-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\VisualEffects' -Name 'VisualFXSetting' -Value 0; Write-Host '✅ Efeitos visuais restaurados!' -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Desativar Animacoes do Windows
operations.command: Set-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop\WindowMetrics' -Name 'MinAnimate' -Value 0; Write-Host '✅ Animacoes desativadas!' -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Prioridade de CPU para Jogos (Temp)
operations.command: wmic process where name='javaw.exe' call setpriority 'high priority'; Write-Host '✅ Prioridade alta aplicada!' -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Limpar Cache de Sombras (GPU)
operations.command: Get-ChildItem '$env:LOCALAPPDATA\NVIDIA\DXCache' -Recurse -EA 0 | Remove-Item -Force -EA 0; Get-ChildItem '$env:LOCALAPPDATA\AMD\DxCache' -Recurse -EA 0 | Remove-Item -Force -EA 0; Write-Host '✅ Cache de GPU limpo!' -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Criar Ponto de Restauração
operations.command: Enable-ComputerRestore -Drive 'C:\'; Checkpoint-Computer -Description 'Mestre do PC - Ponto Manual' -RestorePointType 'MODIFY_SETTINGS'; Write-Host '✅ Ponto de restauração criado!' -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Listar Pontos de Restauração

operations.title: Restaurar do Último Ponto
operations.command: rstrui.exe; Write-Host 'Abrindo assistente de restauração...' -ForegroundColor Cyan

operations.title: Backup de Drivers (Exportar)
operations.command: $dir='$env:USERPROFILE\Desktop\backup-drivers'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dir | Out-Null; Export-WindowsDriver -Online -Destination $dir; Write-Host '✅ Drivers exportados para: $dir' -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Backup do Registro (Completo)
operations.command: $file='$env:USERPROFILE\Desktop\backup-registro-' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss') + '.reg'; reg export HKLM $file /y; reg export HKCU ($file + '.cu') /y; Write-Host '✅ Registro exportado: $file' -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Exportar Lista de Apps Instalados

operations.title: Backup de Hosts

operations.title: Pausar Windows Update (35 dias)

operations.title: Retomar Windows Update
operations.command: Remove-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\WindowsUpdate\UX\Settings' -Name 'PauseFeatureUpdatesStartTime' -EA 0; Write-Host '✅ Windows Update retomado!' -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Histórico de Atualizações
operations.command: Get-HotFix | Sort-Object InstalledOn -Descending | Select-Object -First 20 HotFixID,Description,InstalledOn | Format-Table -AutoSize

operations.title: Desinstalar Atualização Específica
operations.command: wusa /uninstall /kb:NUMERO_KB /quiet /norestart; Write-Host 'Substitua NUMERO_KB pelo KB desejado.' -ForegroundColor Yellow

operations.title: Forçar Busca de Atualizações
operations.command: UsoClient StartScan; Write-Host '✅ Busca de atualizações iniciada!' -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Instalar Atualizações Pendentes

operations.title: Listar Atualizações Recusadas
operations.command: Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\WindowsUpdate\Auto Update\Updates' -EA 0 | Format-List

operations.title: Resetar Componentes do Windows Update
operations.command: net stop wuauserv; net stop cryptSvc; net stop bits; net stop msiserver; ren 'C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution' 'SoftwareDistribution.bak'; ren 'C:\Windows\System32\catroot2' 'catroot2.bak'; net start wuauserv; net start cryptSvc; net start bits; net start msiserver; Write-Host '✅ Componentes do WU resetados!' -ForegroundColor Green

operations.title: Listar Todos os Drivers

operations.title: Listar Drivers de Terceiros

operations.title: Ver Uso RAM (MCP)
operations.command: $ram = Get-WmiObject Win32_OperatingSystem; $livre = [math]::Round($ram.FreePhysicalMemory/1MB,2); $total = [math]::Round($ram.TotalVisibleMemorySize/1MB,2); Write-Host "RAM Livre: $livre GB de $total GB"

operations.title: Diagnóstico Completo (MCP)
operations.command: Write-Host "===== DIAGNÓSTICO COMPLETO =====" -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ""; Write-Host "--- RAM ---" -ForegroundColor Yellow; $ram = Get-WmiObject Win32_OperatingSystem; $livre = [math]::Round($ram.FreePhysicalMemory/1MB,2); $total = [math]::Round($ram.TotalVisibleMemorySize/1MB,2); Write-Host "RAM Livre: $livre GB de $total GB"; Write-Host ""; Write-Host "--- DISCO ---" -ForegroundColor Yellow; Get-PSDrive -PSProvider FileSystem | Select-Object Name,@{N="Usado(GB)";E={[math]::Round(($_.Used/1GB),2)}},@{N="Livre(GB)";E={[math]::Round(($_.Free/1GB),2)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Host "--- TOP 10 PROCESSOS (RAM) ---" -ForegroundColor Yellow; Get-Process | Sort-Object WorkingSet64 -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 Name,@{N="RAM(MB)";E={[math]::Round($_.WorkingSet64/1MB,2)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Host "--- REDE ---" -ForegroundColor Yellow; Test-Connection 8.8.8.8 -Count 1 -Quiet | ForEach-Object { if($_){Write-Host "Internet: OK" -ForegroundColor Green}else{Write-Host "Internet: SEM CONEXÃO" -ForegroundColor Red} }

operations.title: Abrir Pasta Logs (MCP)

templates.title: Encerrar Processo
templates.pattern: Stop-Process -Name "{{NOME}}" -Force -EA 0; if ($?) { Write-Host "✅ Processo {{NOME}} encerrado com sucesso!" -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host "⚠️ Processo {{NOME}} não encontrado ou já encerrado." -ForegroundColor Yellow }

templates.title: Desativar Serviço
templates.pattern: Set-Service -Name "{{NOME_SERVICO}}" -StartupType Disabled -EA 0; Stop-Service -Name "{{NOME_SERVICO}}" -Force -EA 0; if ($?) { Write-Host "✅ Serviço {{NOME_SERVICO}} desativado!" -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host "⚠️ Serviço {{NOME_SERVICO}} não encontrado." -ForegroundColor Yellow }

templates.title: Desinstalar Atualização Específica
templates.pattern: wusa /uninstall /kb:{{NUMERO_KB}} /quiet /norestart; Write-Host "Substitua NUMERO_KB pelo KB desejado." -ForegroundColor Yellow
